p2-b6.notes: Two real bugs found and fixed beyond the original description: (a) the listing/day/date-range/season narrowing controls in BookingsList.tsx were local useState, never in the URL or store at all — moved into the zustand store (listingFilter/dayFilter/rangeFilter/seasonFilter + setters) so BookingsApp can mirror them.
